summary: EchoStar Corp filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary DISH DBS Corporation made delayed interest payments on three series of notes (5.25% secured notes due 2026, 5.75% secured notes due 2028, and 5.125% unsecured notes due 2029) within the 30-day grace period, avoiding an Event of Default. The payments were deferred to preserve liquidity pending receipt of $20.25 billion from the AT&T Transactions, which have received FCC and DOJ approvals but remain subject to final FCC order and other closing conditions. This filing reflects debt management and liquidity planning rather than a transformative event.
